# Contributing to Universal File Converter

Thank you for your interest in contributing to **Universal File Converter** ([`Hasan580/universial-file-converter`](https://github.com/Hasan580/universial-file-converter))!

## Code of Conduct
Please be polite, respectful, and collaborative.

## How to Contribute
1. **Report Bugs**: Check existing issues before opening a new issue with steps to reproduce and logs.
2. **Suggest Enhancements**: Share ideas for new formats, UI improvements, or performance optimizations.
3. **Submit Pull Requests**:
   - Fork the repository: `https://github.com/Hasan580/universial-file-converter`.
   - Create a feature branch: `git checkout -b feature/my-feature`.
   - Ensure `npm start` runs without errors and node syntax checks pass.
   - Commit your changes with descriptive messages.
   - Push to your fork and submit a PR to `main`.

## Attribution
All contributions become part of the open-source repository under the [MIT License](../LICENSE). Please preserve attribution to the original project `Hasan580/universial-file-converter`.
